name: Alzchem Group AG
summary: Alzchem Group AG engages in the provision of development, production, and marketing of chemical products. It operates through the following segments: Specialty Chemicals, Basics & Intermediates, and Other & Holding. The Specialty Chemicals segment focuses on the production and distribution of growth products that contain specialty chemicals such as CreAMINO, Creapure, BioSelect, Silzot, DYHARD, and Dormex. The Basics & Intermediates segment covers the production of basic and intermediate products. The Other & Holding segment comprises services to the chemical parks in Trostberg and Hart. The company was founded on October 10, 1984 is headquartered in Trostberg, Germany.
